newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil pressured by supplies.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil pressured by supplies.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil came under some initial pressure on Tuesday after weaker crude futures on Monday and only modestly took support from the later upturn. A deal was done at $126 fob NWE for a prompt loading, the weak price reflecting the date. Another cargo was offered around $129 fob NWE, which was closer to the market.

High sulphur straight-run prices were steady, but came under pressure because of good supplies. Traders estimated that up to eight M-100 cargoes have to find homes before the end of the month in addition to a handful of E-4s. E-4 were assessed at formula +$2 while M-100s were around two quotes +$2.
